headlines.title: Constellation shares up 4% in premarket trade on Q3 earnings beat, higher outlook
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Constellation Energy (NASDAQ:CEG) shares advanced over 4% in premarket trading on Monday after the U.S. nuclear and power producer beat third-quarter profit expectations by a wide margin and raised the midpoint of its full-year earnings forecast.

headlines.summary: Constellation Energy raises full-year earnings guidance even as the U.S midterm elections have made some on Wall Street concerned the data-center buildout could stall.

headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy is down 17% in the past month. It gave back its jump on a big Google deal as investors sold AI power stocks, along with Vistra and GE Vernova.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
